description: This module allows the installation of Ansible collections or roles using ansible-galaxy.

parameters.name: dest
parameters.description: The path to the directory containing your collections or roles, according to the value of type. Please notice that ansible-galaxy does not install collections with type=both, when requirements_file contains both roles and collections and dest is specified.

parameters.name: executable
parameters.description: Path to the ansible-galaxy executable. When not specified, the module uses ansible-galaxy found by Ansible.

parameters.name: force
parameters.description: Force overwriting existing roles and/or collections. It can be used for upgrading, but the module output always reports changed=true. Using force=true is mandatory when downgrading. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Name of the collection or role being installed. Versions can be specified with ansible-galaxy usual formats. For example, the collection community.docker:1.6.1 or the role ansistrano.deploy,3.8.0. name and requirements_file are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: no_deps
parameters.description: Refrain from installing dependencies. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: requirements_file
parameters.description: Path to a file containing a list of requirements to be installed. It works for type equals to collection and role. name and requirements_file are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: If state=present then the collection or role is installed. Note that the collections and roles are not updated with this option. Currently the state=latest is ignored unless type=collection, and it ensures the collection is installed and updated to the latest available version. Please note that force=true can be used to perform upgrade regardless of type. Choices: "present" ← (default) "latest"

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The type of installation performed by ansible-galaxy. If type=both, then requirements_file must be passed and it may contain both roles and collections. Note however that the opposite is not true: if using a requirements_file, then type can be any of the three choices. Choices: "collection" "role" "both"

examples:
- name: Install collection community.network
  community.general.ansible_galaxy_install:
    type: collection
    name: community.network

- name: Install role at specific path
  community.general.ansible_galaxy_install:
    type: role
    name: ansistrano.deploy
    dest: /ansible/roles

- name: Install collections and roles together
  community.general.ansible_galaxy_install:
    type: both
    requirements_file: requirements.yml

- name: Force-install collection community.network at specific version
  community.general.ansible_galaxy_install:
    type: collection
    name: community.network:3.0.2
    force: true

return_values.name: dest
return_values.description: The value of the dest parameter. Returned: always

return_values.name: force
return_values.description: The value of the force parameter. Returned: always

return_values.name: installed_collections
return_values.description: If requirements_file is specified instead, returns dictionary with all the collections installed per path. If name is specified, returns that collection name and the version installed per path. Returned: always when installing collections Sample: {"/custom/ansible/ansible_collections": {"community.general": "3.1.0"}, "/home/az/.ansible/collections/ansible_collections": {"community.docker": "1.6.0", "community.general": "3.0.2"}}

return_values.name: <path>
return_values.description: Collections and versions for that path. Returned: success

return_values.name: installed_roles
return_values.description: If requirements_file is specified instead, returns dictionary with all the roles installed per path. If name is specified, returns that role name and the version installed per path. Returned: always when installing roles Sample: {"/custom/ansible/roles": {"ansistrano.deploy": "3.8.0"}, "/home/user42/.ansible/roles": {"ansistrano.deploy": "3.9.0", "baztian.xfce": "v0.0.3"}}

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: The value of the name parameter. Returned: always

return_values.name: new_collections
return_values.description: New collections installed by this module. Returned: success Sample: {"community.docker": "1.6.1", "community.general": "3.1.0"}

return_values.name: new_roles
return_values.description: New roles installed by this module. Returned: success Sample: {"ansistrano.deploy": "3.8.0", "baztian.xfce": "v0.0.3"}

return_values.name: requirements_file
return_values.description: The value of the requirements_file parameter. Returned: always

return_values.name: type
return_values.description: The value of the type parameter. Returned: always

return_values.name: version
return_values.description: Version of ansible-core for ansible-galaxy. Returned: always Sample: "2.17.4"
